conventions.rate_limit: none since static hosting (Nov 2018); fair use policy applies, abusers IP-banned
fair_use: Locally cache resources whenever you request them
conventions.url_placeholder: Doc examples use $BASE_URL; real responses contain absolute https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/... URLs
conventions.id_extraction: Every NamedAPIResource/APIResource carries a url ending in /{id}/; parse the trailing integer to get a foreign key
